title: Studio 154 Hotel - Legendary Loft Suite
description: The Legend Loft Suite is one of Studio 154 Luxury Hotel's best accommodations. You'll step into a modern, 740 sq ft, two-story loft style suite that sleeps up to 4 guests with an en-suite kitchen.  With 10 ft windows overlooking 2nd Ave North, this Suite allows you to feel fully immersed in the nightlife of the city. All guests also have access to the SKYDECK - rooftop with waterfront panoramic views of the Cumberland River and the Nashville skyline.
